text:
ana_cs: Heads-up — Manticore renewal is next week. Procurement wants split invoices across Manticore US and Manticore APAC, requests a 6-month term (instead of annual), and asks that onboarding can start as soon as the PO is uploaded. Need pricing and legal alignment.
mike_sales: looping in @dina_legal and @sam_fin. Any immediate no-gos on split-entity SOWs?
dina_legal: We can do split billing. SOW has to list each legal entity and corresponding billing lines + acceptance of tax/responsibility. Also recommend a clause: "start-on-PO" limited to pre-onboarding view + reserved seats, not full product warranty activation.
sam_fin: Finance note — standard proration for 6mo is ~54% of annual. To keep margin recommend a +3.5% uplift on the prorated subtotal. Alternatively we could keep annual list and invoice two equal installments but that complicates discounts.
ellis_onboard: We can schedule a pre-kickoff walkthrough and reserve 2 enablement seats. Full SSO, seat provisioning, and production integrations must wait for signed contract or an explicit PO acceptance clause.
ana_cs: (typo) ana_cs: Customer offered a compromise at 1735552600: accept 6mo at +3.5% and keep 2 onboarding credits. They will try to upload PO by EOD.
mike_sales: I'll send PO template + DocuSign amendment and ask for vendor code and exact entity identifiers. Will mark renewal row as non-standard in tracker.
renewal-bot: Reminder — renewal:manticore in 5 days. Action items: pricing approval, DocuSign amendment, PO template.
mike_sales: Sent amendment link and PO template to customer at 1735553005. Included sample invoice lines and vendor code field.
ana_cs: (typo) ana_cs: Noted. Holding full seat activations pending PO/signature. We'll run pre-kickoff sessions once PO visible.

---

Sample PO/invoice snippet shared with customer:
```
Billing Line 1:
- entity: Manticore Inc (EIN: 67-8901234)
- scope: US seats + onboarding credits
Billing Line 2:
- entity: Manticore APAC Pte Ltd (UEN: 201900123A)
- scope: APAC seats
Vendor code: MANT-2026
Payment terms: Net30 (PO required). Please include PO number on invoice.
```

mike_sales: follow-up scheduled EOD if PO not uploaded. :thumbsup:
